name: Flare
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The price of the Flare project has dropped by more than 95%, which is suspected to be a Rug Pull scam project. Flare token deployers and associated addresses received approximately 4 billion Flare tokens. The scam has so far made around $18.5 million.
